newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OLYMPICS-INNSBRUCK "NO" TO POSSIBLE 2006 OLYMPIC BID.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-INNSBRUCK "NO" TO POSSIBLE 2006 OLYMPIC BID.

text.p: Innsbruck's hopes of a possible bid to host the 2006 Winter Olympics were dampened by a referendum on Sunday in which 52.5 percent of the city's voters were against the idea.

Herwig Von Staa, mayor of the city which hosted the 1964 and 1976 Olympics, said: "This would have been a great opportunity but the population does not want Games. The Olympics are not an issue for Innsbruck anymore."

The outcome boosted the chances for two other Austrian regions. The southern province of Carinthia is preparing a joint bid for the 2006 Games with the Italian city of Tarvisio and Slovenia. Salzburg is considering a joint bid with the German province of Bavaria.
